bays.restriction: Resident permit zone E (Crayford), London Borough of Bexley. During the controlled hours, marked bays are for permit holders; visitors visiting a resident use visitor scratch cards (booklet of 10 for £22; one card validates one day). Zone centre point — the zone's streets are signed at its boundary.
bays.tariff: No hourly visitor tariff — permit holders and visitor scratch cards only
bays.pay: Visitor scratch cards (from residents); permits online from the council
bays.permits: Resident permit £41 for 3 months / £135 for 1 year; visitor scratch cards £22 per booklet of 10 (council permit charges tables)

bays.road: Mill Road car park, Northumberland Heath
bays.restriction: Council car park — Mill Road car park. Season tickets available (local and standard tiers, council season ticket page).
bays.tariff: up to 30 mins £0.90 by phone / £1.10 cash; up to 1 hr £1.50 by phone / £1.70 cash; up to 2 hrs £2.20 by phone / £2.40 cash; up to 4 hrs £3.20 by phone / £3.40 cash; up to 12 hrs £5.50 by phone / £5.70 cash. Overnight: up to 12 hrs £1.30 by phone / £1.50 cash. Up to 24 hrs not available. Prices by phone exclude the provider's service charge (London Gazette notice 4925320, charges from 21 July 2025)
bays.pay: Pay by phone (prices exclude the service charge) or by cash at the machine
